the.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.

roman.definition: One of the main three types used for the Latin alphabet (the others being italics and blackletter), in which the ascenders are mostly straight.

henry.definition: In the International System of Units, the derived unit of electrical inductance; the inductance induced in a circuit by a rate of change of current of one ampere per second and a resulting electromotive force of one volt. Symbol: H

diocese.definition: Administrative division of the later Roman Empire, starting with the tetrarchy.

west.definition: One of the four principal compass points, specifically 270°, conventionally directed to the left on maps; the direction of the setting sun at an equinox, abbreviated as W.

catholic.definition: Of the Western Christian church, as differentiated from e.g. the Orthodox church.

sixth.definition: (not used in the plural) The person or thing in the sixth position.

bishop.definition: An overseer of congregations: either any such overseer, generally speaking, or (in Eastern Orthodoxy, Catholicism, Anglicanism, etc.) an official in the church hierarchy (actively or nominally) governing a diocese, supervising the church's priests, deacons, and property in its territory.

north.definition: One of the four major compass points, specifically 0°, directed toward the North Pole, and conventionally upwards on a map, abbreviated as N.

summer.definition: One of four seasons, traditionally the second, marked by the longest and typically hottest days of the year due to the inclination of the Earth and thermal lag. Typically regarded as being from June 21 to September 22 or 23 in parts of the USA, the months of June, July and August in the United Kingdom and the months of December, January and February in the Southern Hemisphere.

earned.definition: To gain (success, reward, recognition) through applied effort or work.

colonel.definition: A commissioned officer in an armed military organization, typically the highest rank before flag officer ranks (generals). It is generally found in armies, air forces or naval infantry (marines).

injured.definition: To wound or cause physical harm to a living creature.

team.definition: A set of draught animals, such as two horses in front of a carriage.

service.definition: An act of being of assistance to someone.

third.definition: The person or thing in the third position.

lieutenant.definition: The lowest Junior Commissioned Officer rank(s) in many military forces, often Army and Marines.

distinguished.definition: To recognize someone or something as different from others based on its characteristics.

romantic.definition: Of or dealing with languages or cultures derived from Roman influence and Latin: Italian, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Romanian, Catalan, Occitan, Corsican, etc.

written.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

documentary.definition: A film, TV program, publication etc. which presents a social, political, scientific or historical subject in a factual or informative manner.

county.definition: The land ruled by a count or a countess.

river.definition: A large and often winding stream which drains a land mass, carrying water down from higher areas to a lower point, oftentimes ending in another body of water, such as an ocean or in an inland sea.

around.definition: (with the verb "to be") Present in the vicinity.

population.definition: The people living within a political or geographical boundary.

near.definition: The left side of a horse or of a team of horses pulling a carriage etc.

lies.definition: The terrain and conditions surrounding the ball before it is struck.

district.definition: An administrative division of an area.

valley.definition: An elongated depression between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it.

parish.definition: In the Anglican, Eastern Orthodox, Lutheran and Roman Catholic Church, an administrative part of a diocese that has its own church.

this.definition: Something being indicated that is here; one of these.

lark.definition: Any of various small, singing passerine birds of the family Alaudidae.

from.definition: Used to indicate source or provenance.

difficult.definition: To make difficult; to impede; to perplex.

murder.definition: The crime of deliberately killing another person without justification.

determined.definition: To set the boundaries or limits of.

consultant.definition: A person or party that is consulted

formerly.definition: At some time in the past

later.definition: Near the end of a period of time.

teacher.definition: A person who teaches, especially one employed in a school.

member.definition: One who officially belongs to a group.

politician.definition: One engaged in politics, especially an elected or appointed government official.

independent.definition: A candidate or voter not affiliated with any political party, a freethinker, free of a party platform.

labour.definition: Effort expended on a particular task; toil, work.

career.definition: One's calling in life; a person's occupation; one's profession.

parliament.definition: A formal council summoned (especially by a monarch) to discuss important issues.

walker.definition: The agent noun of to walk: a person who walks or a thing which walks, especially a pedestrian or a participant in a walking race.

worked.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

southern.definition: Someone from one of the states which seceded in 1861 and briefly formed the Confederate States of America, or, more broadly, from some neighboring states as well (but excluding geographically-southerly states like Arizona); compare the South.

lesser.definition: A thing that is of smaller size, value, importance etc.

administrative.definition: Of or relating to administering or administration.

within.definition: In the context of which the present document or ruling is made.

classical.definition: One that is classical in some way; for example, a classical economist.

antiquity.definition: Ancient times; faraway history; former ages

active.definition: A person or thing that is acting or capable of acting.

broadcaster.definition: An organisation that engages in the activity of broadcasting.

obe.definition: A particular subdivision of ancient Laconia.

encourage.definition: To mentally support; to motivate, give courage, hope or spirit.

state.definition: A condition; a set of circumstances applying at any given time.

teaching.definition: Something taught by a religious or philosophical authority.

specialising.definition: To make distinct or separate, particularly:

twin.definition: Either of two people (or, less commonly, animals) who shared the same uterus at the same time; one who was born at the same birth as a sibling.

side.definition: A bounding straight edge of a two-dimensional shape.

defender.definition: Someone who defends people or property

pro.definition: An advantage of something, especially when contrasted with its disadvantages (cons).

brother.definition: Son of the same parents as another person.

residential.definition: A trip during which people temporarily live together.

current.definition: The generally unidirectional movement of a gas or fluid.

neighborhood.definition: The quality of being a neighbor, of living nearby, next to each-other; proximity.

system.definition: A collection of organized things; a whole composed of relationships among its members.

street.definition: A paved part of road, usually in a village or a town.

ward.definition: A warden; a guard; a guardian or watchman.

western.definition: A film, or some other dramatic work, set in, the historic (c. 1850-1910) American West (west of the Mississippi river) focusing on conflict between whites and Indians, lawmen and outlaws, ranchers and farmers, or industry (railroads, mining) and agriculture.

which.definition: (interrogative) What one or ones (of those mentioned or implied).

project.definition: A planned endeavor, usually with a specific goal and accomplished in several steps or stages.

ghats.definition: A descending path or stairway to a river; a ford or landing-place.

eastern.definition: Of, facing, situated in, or related to the east.

foundation.definition: The act of founding, fixing, establishing, or beginning to erect.

constituent.definition: A part, or component of a whole

king.definition: A male monarch; a man who heads a monarchy. If it's an absolute monarchy, then he is the supreme ruler of his nation.

royal.definition: A royal person; a member of a royal family.

oxford.definition: A variety of shoe, typically made of heavy leather.

historically.definition: In a historic manner; with reference to history or the historical record.

square.definition: A polygon with four sides of equal length and four right angles; an equilateral rectangle; a regular quadrilateral.

distinction.definition: That which distinguishes; a single occurrence of a determining factor or feature, the fact of being divided; separation, discrimination.

brazil.definition: A red-orange dye obtained from brazil wood.

bird.definition: A member of the class of animals Aves in the phylum Chordata, characterized by being warm-blooded, having feathers and wings usually capable of flight, and laying eggs.

narrow.definition: (chiefly in the plural) A narrow passage, especially a contracted part of a stream, lake, or sea; a strait connecting two bodies of water.

family.definition: A group of people who are closely related to one another (by blood, marriage or adoption); kin; for example, a set of parents and their children; an immediate family.

subfamily.definition: A taxonomic category ranking between a family and a genus; formerly called a tribe

region.definition: Any considerable and connected part of a space or surface; specifically, a tract of land or sea of considerable but indefinite extent; a country; a district; in a broad sense, a place without special reference to location or extent but viewed as an entity for geographical, social or cultural reasons.

republic.definition: A state where sovereignty rests with the people or their representatives, rather than with a monarch or emperor; a country with no monarchy.

inhabitants.definition: Someone or thing who lives in a place.

railway.definition: A transport system using rails used to move passengers or goods.

operated.definition: To perform a work or labour; to exert power or strength, physical or mechanical; to act.

bordeaux.definition: A wine coming from that area.

services.definition: An act of being of assistance to someone.

local.definition: A person who lives near a given place.

line.definition: A path through two or more points (compare ‘segment’); a continuous mark, including as made by a pen; any path, curved or straight.

many.definition: A multitude; a great aggregate; a mass of people; the generality; the common herd.

itself.definition: (reflexive pronoun) it; A thing as the object of a verb or preposition that also appears as the subject

experts.definition: A person with extensive knowledge or ability in a given subject.

neo.definition: A newcomer to science fiction; a fan who is extremely new and inexperienced with the genre; a beginner.

mouth.definition: The opening of a creature through which food is ingested.

sold.definition: (ditransitive) To transfer goods or provide services in exchange for money.

dopamine.definition: A neurotransmitter associated with movement, attention, learning, and the brain’s pleasure and reward system.

medication.definition: A medicine, or all the medicines regularly taken by a patient.

award.definition: A judgment, sentence, or final decision. Specifically: The decision of arbitrators in a case submitted.

operatic.definition: Of, related to, or typical of opera.

principal.definition: The money originally invested or loaned, on which basis interest and returns are calculated.

awarded.definition: To give by sentence or judicial determination; to assign or apportion, after careful regard to the nature of the case; to adjudge

portrayed.definition: To paint or draw the likeness of.

register.definition: A machine that tabulates the amount of sales transactions, makes a permanent and cumulative record of them, and has a drawer in which cash can be kept.

residence.definition: The place where one lives; one's home.

house.definition: A structure built or serving as an abode of human beings.

added.definition: To join or unite (e.g. one thing to another, or as several particulars) so as to increase the number, augment the quantity or enlarge the magnitude, or so as to form into one aggregate.

preserved.definition: To protect; to keep from harm or injury.

empire.definition: (furniture) Following or imitating a style popular during the First French Empire (1804–1814).

style.definition: Senses relating to a thin, pointed object.

historic.definition: A history, a non-fiction account of the past.

places.definition: (physical) An area; somewhere within an area.

second.definition: Something that is number two in a series.

example.definition: Something that is representative of all such things in a group.

people.definition: Used as plural of person; a body of human beings considered generally or collectively; a group of two or more persons.

prior.definition: A high-ranking member of a monastery, usually lower in rank than an abbot.

draft.definition: A current of air, usually coming into a room or vehicle.

commanders.definition: One who exercises control and direction of a military or naval organization.

back.definition: The rear of the body, especially the part between the neck and the end of the spine and opposite the chest and belly.

defensive.definition: A means, attitude or position of defense.

seventh.definition: The person or thing in the seventh position.

selected.definition: To choose one or more elements of a set, especially a set of options.

buckeyes.definition: Any of several species of trees of the genus Aesculus.

football.definition: (general) A sport played on foot in which teams attempt to get a ball into a goal or zone defended by the other team.

played.definition: To act in a manner such that one has fun; to engage in activities expressly for the purpose of recreation or entertainment.

styles.definition: Senses relating to a thin, pointed object.

devon.definition: (Eastern Australia) A type of processed meat sausage.
